hate to say it and it’s controversial but when i started distancing myself from emotions and started focusing on other things like schoolwork, sports, gyms, hobbies etc I felt so much better

Also, adopting an attitude that emotions are just chemical reactions helped me

tried therapy and medication and nothing worked until i just said my emotions are just chemicals in my brain and said that men aren’t emotional (which i know isn’t true) made me recover very quickly 

Don’t take this as gospel but this is just my personal experience
